purpose: Dimensional evidence for an original visualization reconstruction; no third-party mesh geometry is included.

sources.authority: Original author of a reverse-engineered non-EA Genesis shell model; hardware supplier, not Sega.
sources.publisherBasis: The publisher describes the design as a close dimensional copy of an original Genesis shell and offers it for prototyping.
sources.method: Parsed binary STL facets. Computed envelopes from vertex extrema. Isolated coplanar triangles, removed shared interior edges, and measured remaining boundary loops. Circular-loop centers came from opposite extrema. Inspected orthographic projections to identify the rear grip, screw wells, and front label land. No source mesh was imported into a deliverable.
sources.unitInterpretation: STL has no native unit declaration. Coordinates are interpreted as millimeters, consistent with the physical scale and independent cartridge measurements.
limits: These are measurements of the publisher's reverse-engineered STL, not fresh measurements of a Sega specimen or official manufacturing dimensions.
The separate-part depth values must not be added to claim an assembled thickness; the parts include overlapping assembly features.
The two modeled halves have slightly different screw-center spacing and offsets. Rounded nominal dimensions are more defensible than claiming factory precision.
No unambiguous complete connector-opening section or official screw dimensions were recovered from this extraction.

sources.authority: First-person physical measurement of cartridges using a ruler and caliper, published in 2016.
limits: The measurements are informal, with no calibration or uncertainty statement.
The article separately mentions a 12 mm outer groove height; this must not be substituted for its 9 mm interior depth.
The article does not establish precise screw spacing or nominal full shell width and height.

sources.authority: Community template explicitly marked confirmed through test printing and fitting to an OEM cartridge and label.
limits: Fit confirmation is not a Sega engineering drawing or manufacturing tolerance specification.
The nominal front height is the unfolded height minus the listed top fold, not an independently measured flat surface including bend allowances.

sources.authority: Primary production artwork specification for the supplier's Mega EverDrive replacement label.
limits: This is an aftermarket label specification and differs from the OEM-fit community template. It corroborates overall scale, not exact original dimensions.

sources.publisher: ConsoleMods contributors; Sega row attributed to NagaTen
sources.authority: Community physical-dimension table with a named contributor.
limits: The table and prose conflict on width and height. Neither is treated as an exact certified dimension.
HDRV independently supports approximately 109 by 70 mm; Aaltomies independently reports 17 mm thickness.

sources.authority: Primary manufacturer's dimensional inspection criteria for its Original Jewel Case product, measured by caliper.
limits: CMC specifications apply to its case product. They are a standard-compatible dimensional basis, not proof of exact Sony packaging tooling.

sources.authority: Primary product specification for printed inserts intended for standard jewel cases.
limits: This source establishes the flat sheet size, not a Sony-specific paper thickness or booklet page count.

sources.authority: CD-ROM physical interchange standard, second edition, June 1996.
limits: The standard supports nominal physical dimensions, not the printed artwork, dark PlayStation appearance, or exact extent of a photographed clear center.

corroboration.finding: A western Genesis shell envelope near 109 by 70 by 17 mm is supported as a visualization nominal.
corroboration.status: Approximate cross-source agreement; no factory tolerance or new specimen measurement.

corroboration.finding: The front label occupies about 74 mm width and 60 mm front height, then folds about 7 mm over the top.
corroboration.status: The sources agree on scale and folded construction but differ on exact cut dimensions and corner radii.

corroboration.finding: Standard single-disc jewel-case and compact-disc dimensions have independent primary manufacturer or standards sources.
corroboration.status: These sources do not certify exact historic Sony packaging molds.
